integrity: The proof independently classifies all minimum zero forcing sets from the color-change rule, then identifies token-jumping adjacency with edge incidence in a compressed complete multipartite graph. A separate checker verifies both layers directly through order ten.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to token-jumping reconfiguration of minimum standard zero forcing sets.
Complete graphs and stars are prior-covered boundary cases.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed multipartite reconfiguration result.
title: Zero forcing graphs of complete multipartite graphs via singleton compression
